ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web. In the lower-right area, there is a labeled component reading “Detritus/Bacteria,” with many arrows pointing into or connected around it from other organisms and organic matter in the web. Other labeled organisms include nekton, carnivores, grazers, deep deposit feeders, omnivores, filter feeders, interface feeders, phytoplankton, and microphytobenthos. Reasoning: The question asks which item fills the blank in “_____ is a decomposer.” In ecology, decomposers break down dead organic material, also called detritus. In the diagram, the relevant decomposer-related label is “Detritus/Bacteria.” Detritus is the dead organic material itself, while bacteria are living organisms that decompose it. Therefore, the blank should be filled with “Bacteria.”
